identification: Early Victorian (William IV / early Victorian, c1840-1860) flame mahogany toilet (dressing table) swing mirror: rectangular cushion-moulded flame-veneered mirror frame pivoting between two plain turned column supports with carved lotus/cushion finials and gadrooned collars, on a serpentine breakfront plinth base veneered in flame mahogany with an inset white (Carrara-type) marble top, raised on carved scroll/acanthus bracket feet. 98 cm high, so a large table-top mirror. Bevel-less plate with some speckling.
